# Official GATE answer keys (PDF)
Fetched 2026-10-06. Official keys published by the GATE organising institutes (IIT Madras gate2027.iitm.ac.in, IIT Roorkee gate2025.iitr.ac.in archive).
- 2022-2026 CS/CS1/CS2/DA: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/download (static/doc/download/...). 2024_DA_paper.pdf = DA 2024 paper.
- 2020_cs_key_mirror_gfg2.pdf: printout (11 Aug 2023) of IIT Delhi page gate.iitd.ac.in/gate2020/CSKey.php, mirrored at media.geeksforgeeks.org. Final key (Q7 CS = MTA). 2020_cs_key_mirror_gfg.pdf is an older mirror (CS7 = D), superseded. 2020_cs_paper_iitr.pdf = IIT Roorkee archive copy of the 2020 paper with key appended.
- 2019/2021 keys are image-only PDFs (2021_cs_merged_key.pdf); the few missing answers were transcribed by eye from key images in the app bank. 2019_cs_paper_iitr.pdf is the paper.
License/terms: no explicit open license; public downloads from official GATE sites, kept for personal study use only.
